name: Handson Global Management (HGM) Limited
summary: Handson Global Management (HGM) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides software and IT enabled services. The company offers software development, maintenance, support, and related services; data entry and business process outsource services. It is also involved in sale of software licenses. The company was formerly known as HOV Services Limited and changed its name to Handson Global Management (HGM) Limited in August 2025. Handson Global Management (HGM) Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Pune, India.
